The Illinois Basin – Decatur Project (IBDP) is situated in a very
seismically stable area, but that does not mean no seismic
activity will occur in the project area. Microseismic events
can take place at any CO2 injection site because of minor
adjustments deep underground. These minor unfelt events
measure far less than 2 on the Richter scale.
